entry.title: New: Bill 134 (2023) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2024 BUDGET FOR THE COUNTY OF MAUI, OFFICE OF THE MAYOR, ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT PROGRAM, EAST MAUI ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT, ENVIRONMENTAL, AND CULTURAL PROGRAMS" The purpose of this bill is to amend the FY2024 Budget, Office of the Mayor, Economic Development Program, East Maui Economic Development, Environmental, and Cultural Programs, to change “Holani Hāna, Inc.” to “Hāna Canoe Club” and delete the line item for Na Keiki O Lawaiʻa.

View on the council site
